dialogue_texts: To think you could unravel my mirror-world structure so flawlessly...
I suppose the power of the legendary youkai queen wasn't an exaggeration.
Splitting 'left' from 'right' or 'forward' from 'backward' is children's play, dear. But I must admit...
Stitching together leaking parallel timelines is quite a heavy burden for a little mirror-weaver.
So the architectural axes weren't distorted out of malice.
You've been trying to anchor this estate while it's caught in a severe temporal drift.
How perceptive. If I hadn't deployed those inversion charms to seal the inner grounds...
The overlapping dimensions would have crushed everything before the core could stabilize.
But your raw power has completely shattered my boundaries.
Then we shall simply have to go and have a word with whatever is causing this tedious instability at the center.
Agreed. If the temporal rift is widening, we have no time to waste.
